title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theater on 1979-12-01
lineage: Master played back on Nak Dragon> Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe (24/96)>Adobe Audition> (dither/downsample)> FLAC encoding

ai_review.summary: Good-quality fan recording captures a high‑energy show with standout Jack Straw → Sugaree opening, though some listeners find the night less on than other classic performances.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for its vibrant energy and a sweet Jack Straw into Sugaree opener that many fans cite as a highlight. One reviewer praises Joel's recording and the overall excitement, while another feels the performance never quite reaches the intensity of the band’s best nights, calling it slightly overrated.

ai_rating.rationale: One positive (4‑star) and one mixed (3‑star) review; show is praised for energy but also noted as not fully on, recording quality mentioned positively.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the tape was well labeled and praises Joel's recording, indicating a clear and listenable source despite no explicit description of soundboard vs. audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High energy throughout with the band turned on; strong opening transition from Jack Straw into Sugaree, maintaining momentum for the rest of the show.
